name: kimi
notes: Paths verified against Kimi Code's own bundled Claude-importer instructions, which state the user-global mappings explicitly: instructions -> $KIMI_CODE_HOME/AGENTS.md (else ~/.kimi-code/AGENTS.md), skills -> $KIMI_CODE_HOME/skills/ (else ~/.kimi-code/skills/), MCP -> ~/.kimi-code/mcp.json. Commands are deliberately NOT bridged: the same instructions state that Claude custom commands are out of scope, i.e. Kimi offers no equivalent destination. Known limitation: if KIMI_CODE_HOME points elsewhere, the declared paths no longer apply; `doctor` reports this.

managed.note: kept inside Kimi's own directory rather than the shared ~/.agents/skills, so this target never competes with pi for the same path

gates.reason: Kimi Code ships no user-installable extension or hook mechanism that this project can target, so the rules document stays advisory for this harness. Reported in `status` rather than silently skipped.
